\newcommand{\CVBio}{PhD student at ICMAT and Universidad Autónoma de Madrid, supported by an FPU2024 fellowship and supervised by Manuel de León. My research focuses on differential geometry, geometric mechanics, and the geometric formulation of classical field theories.}
\newcommand{\CVEducation}{%
\CVEntry{PhD in Mathematics}{ICMAT and Universidad Autónoma de Madrid}{2024--present}{FPU2024 fellow; supervised by Manuel de León.}

\CVEntry{Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics}{Universidad Complutense de Madrid}{2019--2023}{Average grade: 9.44/10. Bachelor's thesis: Homología Singular y Celular.}
}
\newcommand{\CVResearchExperience}{%
\CVEntry{PhD Researcher}{Instituto de Ciencias Matemáticas (ICMAT)}{2024--present}{For developing by PhD in CSIC (Instituto de Ciencias Matemáticas) under the supervision of Manuel de León.
